standard_prerequisites: Lemma lemma-epsilon-flat (delivered, L48088): the comparison functor epsilon^* is flat, identifying boundedness of E with boundedness of epsilon^*E
Lemma lemma-descend-finite-type (in-source): finiteness of cohomology modules descends from the small etale site
core_obligations: Let X be a scheme and E an object of D(O_X), with epsilon : X_etale -> X as in (equation-epsilon). Then E is m-pseudo-coherent if and only if epsilon^*E is m-pseudo-coherent on the small etale site of X.
proof_roadmap: Direction (1) => (2) is the named pseudo-coherent-pullback lemma.

Direction (2) => (1): work locally, assume X quasi-compact; boundedness of epsilon^*E and epsilon-flatness (delivered L48088) give E in D^-; induct on n - m where n is the top nonzero cohomological degree.

Base step n < m is vacuous. Step: H^n(epsilon^*E) finite on the etale site (named lemma), hence H^n(E) finite on X (lemma-descend-finite-type); after shrinking, choose a surjection O_X^t -> H^n(E) and locally lift it to a map of complexes O_X^t[-n] -> E (standard derived-category lift mechanic, the author's '(details omitted)'); the cone C has vanishing cohomology in degrees >= n and epsilon^*C is m-pseudo-coherent by the cone lemma, so C is m-pseudo-coherent by induction; the cone lemma once more finishes.
difficulty_reason: H2: a descent theorem proved by a complete induction on the top cohomological degree, with boundedness and finiteness reductions carried through named lemmas including the delivered L48088.
